model: FHP / Bosch ES 2-stage single-compressor water-to-air DDC (software 3.10)
aliases: Bosch ES water source heat pump
applies_to: Discontinued FHP / Bosch ES-series two-stage, single-compressor water-to-air heat pumps with the factory DDC controller running software 3.10.
summary: Legacy FHP / Bosch factory DDC controller for ES-series water-to-air heat pumps. One list maps each point to BACnet, Modbus, N2 and LonWorks; on BACnet it is 38 AV/BV objects covering occupancy and setpoints, effective setpoints and temperatures, compressor, fan, reversing valve and aux heat outputs, UPM safety alarms and run-time resets.
notes: This is an archived document for a discontinued product. Newer Bosch Control Air 5600 controllers (WAZ software) use a different object list.
Access comes from the Read Only column; unmarked points are writable network parameters.
BV 2, 3, 6 and 7 are not in the list.
aux_htg_cmd_1 and nsb_status_1 give their states as 1/2 in the list text; kept as printed.
The list does not say which BACnet transport the controller uses; check the controller's own manual (BACview IOM for software 3.10).

source.title: FHP Bosch - Water to Air ES 2 Stage - Single Compressor - Network Integration Points List

integration.summary: Pick the occupancy source with ctrl_source_1 (2 = BAS occupancy command), then command occupancy with enable_bas_1 and write the four occupied/unoccupied setpoints. loop_enabled_1 must be On to allow heating and cooling. Read sys_status_1, the effective setpoints and temperatures, and alm_status_1 / current_alarm_1 for faults.

minimum_points.name: sys_status_1
minimum_points.why: Unoccupied / occupied / fan only / heating / cooling state

integration.enable: ctrl_source_1 (AV 15) selects where occupancy comes from: 0 = digital input 1, 1 = keypad schedule, 2 = BAS occupancy command, 4 = manual on. With 2, enable_bas_1 (BV 1) sets occupancy. loop_enabled_1 (BV 23) Off blocks heating and cooling.
gotchas: The run-time reset and UPM reset points need a momentary On then Off.
The list suggests toggling occupancy or setpoints to clear a UPM fault and using upm_rst_1 only when needed.

points.name: ctrl_source_1
points.states: 0=Digital Input 1, 1=Keypad Schedule, 2=BAS Occupancy Command, 3=Factory Use, 4=Manual On-Continuous

points.name: sys_status_1
points.states: 0=Unoccupied, 1=Occupied, 2=Fan Only, 3=Heating, 4=Cooling, 5=Transition to Cool, 6=Transition to Heat, 7=Manual Cool, 8=Manual Heat

points.name: current_alarm_1
points.states: 0=No Alarm, 1-7=UPM Fault Code, 20=Output Overridden via Keypad, 30=Sensor Failure, 40=Zone Temp Alarm, 50=Discharge Air Temp Alarm, 60=Filter / Comp Run Time Alarm, 70=Leaving Water Temp Alarm
